review_description: The quote we received showed clearly what we would save in energy bills, how to utilise the system and this was very well explained by Cam prior to quote acceptance.Cam's knowledge and ease of explaining to us how Solar would benefit our property is what initiated us to install solar. The pricing was fair and knowing we have a local company to refer back to if required with any support is #1 for is as well.The installation was faultless, the team was friendly and efficient.If you value honest advise and follow up once a system is installed, local B&G we recommend B&G Electrical.
